help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Find answers to your questions
help.faq1Q: How do I create a new project?
help.faq1A: Click the "New Project" button in your dashboard or sidebar. You'll be taken to the editor where you can start adding media to your timeline.
help.faq2Q: How do I share a project with my team?
help.faq2A: Open your project in the editor, click the Share button in the toolbar, and enter the email addresses of the people you want to share with.
help.faq3A: AloMedia supports exporting in MP4, WebM, and other popular formats. Choose your preferred format from the export dialog.
help.faq4Q: How do I recover a deleted project?
help.faq4A: Unfortunately, deleted projects cannot be recovered at this time. We recommend exporting important projects regularly.
help.faq5A: Yes! AloMedia supports keyboard shortcuts for common actions like play/pause (Space), undo (Ctrl+Z), redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z), and more.
help.gettingStartedText: New to AloMedia? Start by creating a project from your dashboard, then drag media files onto the timeline to begin editing.
help.needMoreHelpText: If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact our support team.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your data
privacy.collectionText: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and the content you upload. We also collect usage data to improve our service.

privacy.sharingText: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with service providers who help us operate our platform, subject to strict confidentiality agreements.
privacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit and at rest.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at privacy@alomedia.com to exercise these rights.
privacy.cookiesText: We use cookies to maintain your session and preferences. You can manage cookie settings in your browser.
